incidents.name: AaveBoost proxyDeposit credits caller with the contract's own balance
incidents.notes: AaveBoost.proxyDeposit(token, onBehalfOf, amount) is permissionless and, when called with amount 0, deposits a fixed slice of the helper contract's own AAVE holdings into the Aave pool crediting the caller-supplied beneficiary, so 163 repeated calls transferred the contract's AAVE balance into aAAVE owned by the attacker, who then withdrew it.

sources.ref: onchain review: AaveBoost 0xd2933c86216dC0c938FfAFEca3C8a2D6e633e2cA created 2022-02-15T10:49:38Z by 0xcb7d8a80c3d7d3ebd7fbd0fa6b644c8a536c9269, not the attack-tx sender 0x5d4430d14ae1d11526ddac1c1ef01da3b1dae455; no EIP-1967 events, 1212.6 days old. Reported loss 14.8k USD in AAVE.
